title: Order Reversal Fee on Large Microsoft 365 Subscription Cancellations
content:
**Fee clause.** For license work not covered by ClearPath, reversing a large Microsoft 365 Cloud Subscriptions (CSP) order deducts Stratton Bay's order reversal fee from the cancellation refund.

- 25 or more licenses cancelled: **50.00 USD**;
- 10 to 24 licenses cancelled: **25.00 USD**;
- fewer than 10 licenses cancelled: nothing.

**Licenses cancelled.** These are the licenses the subscription carries at cancellation: the licenses its quantity changes have added, less those they have removed.

**Covered work.** License work is covered by ClearPath for a client holding a ClearPath agreement whose status is active or notice given and whose tier includes Microsoft 365 administration. For such a client, no order reversal fee is deducted.

## Band table

| Licenses cancelled | Order reversal fee, license work not covered | Covered by ClearPath |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | nothing | nothing |
| 10 | 25.00 USD | nothing |
| 24 | 25.00 USD | nothing |
| 25 | 50.00 USD | nothing |
| 80 | 50.00 USD | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

A client without ClearPath coverage cancels a subscription carrying 30 licenses: an initial 26, plus a seat addition of 6, less an in-window reduction of 2. The licenses cancelled number 30, so 50.00 USD is deducted from the cancellation refund. Had the reduction been 8 licenses, 24 would be cancelled and 25.00 USD deducted.
